overview_description.description: Formance provides Structural Insulated Panels (SIPs) for use in residential construction. These panels are designed to support energy-efficient and sustainable building practices. The company offers solutions intended to streamline the construction process and improve building performance through customizable panel systems suited to various architectural needs.

product.name: Formance Structural Insulated Panels (SIPs)
product.description: Composite panels with foam insulation sandwiched between structural boards, used for walls, roofs, and floors in residential and commercial buildings to provide thermal efficiency and structural strength.

product.name: Formance Prenail Panels
product.description: Pre-assembled SIP wall, roof, or ceiling sections with timber inserts and fixings, designed for faster on-site installation in residential and commercial builds.

product.name: Formance Design Guide
product.description: A comprehensive guide for designing and consenting buildings using Formance SIPs, facilitating compliance with New Zealand building standards without extra structural engineer sign-off.

product.name: Formance Installation Guide
product.description: A practical site guide providing instructions and best practices for installing Formance Structural Insulated Panels on construction sites.

product.name: Formance Consenting Guide
product.description: A guide for territorial authorities and consenting officers to assess and approve building plans and inspections involving Formance SIP systems.
